pro_course_detail.title: Travel English
pro_course_detail.description:
Teaching English to people who might be traveling internationally or even locally because English is used almost everywhere. 
I'll teach on how to understand people you meet that are not speaking the same language that you speak,  and learn to speak with them using English.
Travel English ties in very nicely with the countable and uncountable nouns that you are going to use in your travel communication, such as accommodation/ hotel, language/ suitcase, and many more.
this is the list of places or situations you will need to use English in Hotels or any other accommodations you will need to speak to host family, bellboy, maid reception staff, etc.
Restaurants or pubs- barman or waiter.
Shops - shop assistance
Airport - check-in staff, immigration customs, security people, lost luggage desk staff, etc.
Aeroplan - fellow passengers and cabin staff.
Bus, coach, or train stations - Ticket counter staff, fellow passengers, information desk, ticket barrier staff.
Taxi and Taxi ranks - Driver or other people waiting.
Tourists site - Tour guide ticket office staff.
The streets - passerby or police officers.
There are so many more places that will need your English such as police stations, car rentals, lost luggage, petrol stations, requesting, thanking, responding to offers, greeting, complaining, responding to apologies, responding to suggestions, and many more.
In my classroom, we will be learning Travelling English focusing on vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar, and phonetics.

pro_course_detail.title: English conversational lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
In an English conversational lesson, students can expect to develop their speaking and listening skills while gaining confidence in their ability to communicate effectively in everyday situations. The focus of the lesson will be on practical language use, encouraging students to engage in discussions that reflect real-life scenarios. 

Students will learn about expressing their thoughts and opinions clearly and coherently. Use appropriate vocabulary and phrases for various contexts, such as casual conversations, travel, and work-related discussions. Improve their listening skills through active participation in conversations. Practice pronunciation and intonation to enhance clarity and understanding. 

 Textbooks and Resources: I will use textbooks which provides dialogues and exercises for conversation practice.

Main Focus of the Lesson: The main focus of the lesson will be on fostering natural conversation. This includes: Topic-based discussions where students can express their opinions and share personal experiences. Role-playing exercises that simulate real-life situations, allowing students to practice language in context. Vocabulary expansion related to the chosen topics, helping students to articulate their thoughts more effectively.

 Teaching Methods and Materials: To facilitate learning in an online environment, the following teaching methods and materials will be utilized: Discussion-based Learning I will create a supportive environment that encourages students to share their ideas and engage in dialogue. Open-ended questions will be posed to stimulate conversation.Visual Aids: The use of slides, images, and videos to introduce topics and vocabulary related to conversations will help to retain students' attention and enhance understanding.

Feedback and correction:I will provide Real-time feedback during conversations to help students improve their speaking skills and address any errors in a constructive manner.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
This Business English lesson is designed to help professionals communicate confidently and effectively in the workplace. Whether you're attending meetings, writing emails, or giving presentations, this course will equip you with the right language and skills to excel in any business setting.

By focusing on real-world business scenarios, you’ll learn how to express ideas clearly, engage in professional discussions, and build strong business relationships. The course covers essential communication techniques, industry-specific vocabulary, and strategies for handling negotiations, networking, and workplace interactions.

If you’re looking to advance your career, expand your business opportunities, or improve your professional communication, this course is for you. Develop the confidence to speak and write with clarity, connect with colleagues and clients, and stand out in the global business world.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Exams Purpose
pro_course_detail.description:
English for Exam Purposes is designed to help students prepare effectively for English proficiency tests and academic exams. Whether you're taking IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge exams, or any other English assessment, this course will equip you with the skills needed to excel in reading, writing, listening, and speaking.

Through structured lessons and practice exercises, you’ll learn key exam strategies, time management techniques, and how to answer different question types with confidence. The course focuses on improving grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, and fluency to ensure you perform at your best.

If you want to boost your scores and achieve your academic or professional goals, this course is for you. Gain the confidence to tackle any English exam with ease and maximize your chances of success.

pro_course_detail.title: English Grammar and Vocabulary Development
pro_course_detail.description:
English Grammar and Vocabulary Development is designed to help learners improve their language accuracy and expand their word bank for effective communication. Whether you're a student, professional, or language enthusiast, this course will strengthen your understanding of grammar rules and enhance your vocabulary for everyday and professional use.

Through interactive lessons and practical exercises, you’ll learn how to construct clear and correct sentences, use words appropriately in different contexts, and avoid common mistakes. The course covers essential grammar structures, idioms, phrasal verbs, and advanced vocabulary to help you express yourself more fluently and confidently.

If you want to communicate more effectively, improve your writing, and sound more natural in English, this course is for you. Build a strong foundation in grammar and vocabulary, and take your English skills to the next level.
